understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to solve each KA59 level by moving/selecting the available movable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; completing a level reports WIN and progressing through all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action moved the currently selected piece one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction when not blocked by walls/boundaries; some adjacent objects could potentially be pushable and would shift if pushed, while walls/obstacles could prevent movement. Levels with multiple selectables required using CLICK on an on-screen selectable's pixel position (same coordinate system as player.position/objects) to change which piece was controlled.

understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to solve each KA59 level by moving/selecting the available movable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; completing a level reports WIN and progressing through all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action moved the currently selected piece one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction when not blocked by walls/boundaries; some adjacent objects could potentially be pushable and would shift if pushed, while walls/obstacles could prevent movement. Levels with multiple selectables required using CLICK on an on-screen selectable's pixel position (same coordinate system as player.position/objects) to change which piece was controlled.
